Hi Sarah — thanks for the ledger, I pulled it and cross-referenced with our consumption view. Quick take before a call:

- We see the same aggregate (1.9B); chat-heavy mix aligns with higher per-request context tokens.
- The mid-September latency blips correlate with a model rollout on your side (short bursts of longer tail latency). We ran a candidate latency benchmark (attached) showing differences between standard and quantized variants.
- There's a pattern where nightly batch jobs cause an intra-day spike in requests; caching could smooth the runrate and reduce effective per-token cost.

Recommendation: short staged extension + a 2-week dedicated pilot on a quantized variant in a small Dedicated pool (we can scope compute). Proposed staging:
- Week 0–2: bridge extension (6 weeks total extension requested) to avoid procurement gap
- Pilot concurrently: 2-week dedicated pilot for QA (quantized model)
- KPI: end-to-end P95 latency drop of >=15% and token cost improvement of >=8% for pilot traffic

I've attached our latency benchmark and a one-pager ROI sketch. If that looks ok to you, propose Thu 11/4 14:00 PT — Ben, can you join?

Attachments: latency_benchmarks_q3.pdf

Thanks,
Monica Patel

Sarah / team — thanks for the detail and Daniel for the procurement checklist. A concise economic proposal to align with the recommendation from Monica: 

Staged tranche proposal (practical, minimizes risk):
- Months 0–1 (bridge): +10% commit over current runrate, monthly invoices — gives Luminar breathing room during budget close
- Months 2–3: evaluate pilot results; if KPIs met, step up to +30% commit (pro-rated) with a 90-day price lock for that tranche
- Opt-out: Luminar can opt-out of the step-up if pilot fails KPIs; only pay for realized usage (no automatic billing for the uplift)

ROI sketch (back-of-envelope):
- If pilot reduces P95 by 15% and token cost by 8%, effective TCO reduces ~6–9% depending on traffic mix — typically covers the uplift within 6–8 weeks assuming steady adoption
- We can supply a short runbook for caching + prompt trimming to accelerate savings (Marcus can share).

Next steps I can action: generate an updated quote with monthly invoicing and prepare the extension_term_draft_20261105.docx for legal redline. Monica — I'll drop the Drive link into HubSpot RDW-2026-LUM-1532 after the call.

Ben Carter
